visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men, one wearing a black baseball cap with a skull logo and a green jacket, the other in a brown jacket, sit at a studio table unboxing a 'Topps Diamond Icons 2025' box. (2) Close-up shot of a hand using a craft knife to carefully cut the plastic seal of the ornate white and gold box. (3) The first man pulls out a large commemorative card featuring Julio Rodriguez with a holographic signature; both men show expressions of extreme surprise. (4) The camera focuses on a sequence of player cards being revealed one by one: Aaron Judge, a Nick Kurtz redemption card, and a thick Mike Trout card containing pieces of his game-used cleats. (5) The men exhibit high energy, pointing at the cards and gesturing toward the camera while displaying a 1/1 James Wood superfractor card. (6) The scene transitions to a full-screen digital interface of a mobile application called 'Keelung Gold N', showing various card sets for 大谷翔平 and Faker. (7) A small video bubble in the corner shows the first man sitting inside a car, looking at his smartphone while the app screen displays credit card transaction processing. (8) The app triggers a high-tech animation of a robotic eye opening, leading to a results screen showing several MLB cards being 'drawn'. (9) The man in the bubble cheers loudly as a Faker (Lee Sang-hyeok) autograph card is revealed on the app interface. (10) Final screen shows the app logo with text indicating it is now available for download in Hong Kong.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 2 main creators in the studio, 1 man shown in the mobile bubble.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One man wears a black '47' brand baseball cap and a dark green jacket over a white t-shirt. The second man has short black hair and wears a brown jacket over a black shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The initial scene is a studio with wooden wall panels and collectible items on shelves. Later, the background is a digital app interface and a car interior seen through a PIP bubble.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Professional conversational vocals between two men; BGM is an upbeat, drum-heavy pop-rock track. (2) A sharp metallic 'snip' sound as the box is cut. (3) Sudden loud 'Whoa!' vocalizations from both speakers with high pitch variability as the first card is revealed. (4) Rapid paper rustling sounds as cards are flipped. (5) High-frequency digital 'ding' and sweep SFX accompany the transition to the mobile app interface. (6) A synthesized riser effect builds tension during the credit card processing screen. (7) Mechanical clicking and 'whoosh' sounds sync with the gacha eye animation. (8) A series of bright, percussive chime sounds play as the Faker card appears. (9) Explosive celebratory shouting from the man in the bubble; BGM volume increases to a crescendo. (10) Audio ends with a final brand stinger SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotion for the 'Keelung Gold N' app. It starts by showcasing the thrill of unboxing extremely rare and expensive physical baseball cards (Topps Diamond Icons) to establish a baseline of excitement and value. It then shifts to show how that same experience can be accessed digitally through the app, specifically targeting fans of both MLB and esports (Faker).

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of app UI, download instructions, and promotional slogan for the Hong Kong market.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges physical collectibles with digital gaming/gacha mechanics. High production value and fast cuts keep viewers engaged.
